_about: William James (1842-1910), from Project Gutenberg, beside the reading-lists thread's william-james shelf (Varieties, Pragmatism), which is not duplicated: Psychology: Briefer Course (Macmillan, 1892), The Principles of Psychology vol. II (Holt, 1918 printing; vol. I is on the Adler shelf), The Will to Believe (1897; 1912 impression), Talks to Teachers on Psychology (copyright 1899; Holt, 1925 printing), The Meaning of Truth (1909), A Pluralistic Universe (1909), Memories and Studies (1911) and Essays in Radical Empiricism (1912). All published before 1930, so US public domain. No uids minted.

james-principles-of-psychology-v2-1918: The Principles of Psychology, vol. II (New York: Henry Holt, 1918)
james-will-to-believe-1912: The Will to Believe, and Other Essays in Popular Philosophy, new impression (New York: Longmans, Green, 1912; first ed. 1897)
james-talks-to-teachers-1925: Talks to Teachers on Psychology, and to Students on Some of Life's Ideals (New York: Henry Holt, 1925; copyright 1899)
james-meaning-of-truth-1909: The Meaning of Truth: a sequel to 'Pragmatism' (1909; preface dated August 1909)
james-pluralistic-universe-1909: A Pluralistic Universe: Hibbert Lectures on the present situation in philosophy (1909)
james-memories-and-studies-1911: Memories and Studies (New York: Longmans, Green, 1911)
james-radical-empiricism-1912: Essays in Radical Empiricism, ed. Ralph Barton Perry (New York: Longmans, Green, 1912)
